instructions.question: What emotional attitude does the poster of this Serbian tweet clearly express: positive (joy, love, excitement, praise), negative (distress, anger, contempt, self-loathing, sarcastic mockery), or neutral (no strong feeling, including jokes, observations and chatter)?
instructions.rule: Choose neutral unless a clear, fairly strong feeling is expressed. Witty one-liners, absurd observations, aphorisms, hypotheticals, banter, mild everyday grumbling (school, sleep, weather) and replies with :) :D or swearing are usually neutral. Sarcastic praise, insults, mocking others, and jokes where the poster calls themselves ugly, stupid or a failure are negative. For news headlines and links, follow the reported event: crime, death, scandal or arrest is negative; success, awards, wins, new songs or products, and good news are positive; routine announcements are neutral.

neutral.what: Jokes, ironic or absurd observations, aphorisms, plans, questions, chatty replies, mild daily grumbles and teasing, as well as routine announcements, when no strong feeling stands out.
examples: Igram tenis kao @DjokerNole  ali nemam milione da to I dokazem. (I play tennis like Djokovic but don't have millions to prove it.)
@neuspeliprofil hahha ma jok, dobro je i ovako :D (haha no, it's fine like this)
I tako već tri sata kao učim hemiju (And so for three hours I'm 'studying' chemistry)
Sednica SB UN o Kosovu 10. februara u Njujorku (UN SC session on Kosovo Feb 10 in New York)
neutral.cues: haha, :) :D :P in replies, kao (like/supposedly), jel (is it), ajde (come on), da li (whether), RT of sayings, plain plans or statements
neutral.not_for: Clear excitement or love is positive. Real anger, insults, sadness or harsh self-mockery is negative.

positive.what: Sincere joy, love, admiration, excitement or praise of people, music, shows, sport or events. Also headlines and promotions about successes, wins, awards or new releases.
examples: Uskoro drugi deo House of cards, sjajno! (Second season of House of Cards soon, great!)
Serena Vilijams teniserka godine (Serena Williams tennis player of the year)
Velečasni @Kole_srb dobio aplauz na izlasku iz tunela #kkcz (Reverend @Kole_srb got applause coming out of the tunnel)
positive.cues: sjajno (great), car (king/awesome), srećna (happy), konačno (finally), pobeda (victory), uskoro nova pesma (new song soon), <3 with praise
positive.not_for: Banter or a joke that just carries a smiley is neutral. Mock praise ('lepo je sto ih ... savetuje' / nice that she advises them) is negative.

negative.what: Real complaints, anger, sadness, disappointment, insults, contemptuous sarcasm, political mockery, and jokes that run the poster down. Also headlines about crime, death, corruption or scandal.
examples: Je li to sutra ponedeljak?! Jebi ga, jeste. (Is tomorrow Monday?! Damn, it is.)
RT @Johnny94Serbia: Svake godine provalim koliko sam prethodne bio ružan i glup. Ali svake. (Every year I realize how ugly and stupid I was the year before.)
Srpski bokser ubijen zbog ucene (Serbian boxer killed over blackmail)
negative.cues: jebi ga (damn), glup/debil (stupid/idiot), ružan (ugly), sramota (shame), tuga (sadness), ubijen/uhapšen (killed/arrested), :( , #losaVlada (bad government)
negative.not_for: Light grumbling, teasing a friend, or a funny observation without real bitterness is neutral.
